# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 99 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 51 | Coptic

---

## Saying 99

**1** The disciples said to him: "Your brothers and your mother are waiting outside." He said to them: "The people right here who do what my Father wants — they are my brothers and my mother. They're the ones who will enter my Father's kingdom."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Waiting outside" — the outside as a place of exclusion, not just location
- "The people right here" — the immediacy of the present community
- "What my Father wants" — the will as desire/intention
